 Before you replace it
 What Guildford owners check first 
 Will you take on work in Godalming and Cranleigh?
 Yes, and the rest of Surrey too. A lot of people searching for web design in Godalming assume it needs someone round the corner, but nearly all of this work is done remotely.
 Can I update the site myself?
 These are hand-built static pages, so there is no login or editor to learn, and changes go through Andy. Tell him what has changed and he will say what it involves. What hosting and care at £10 a month covers is set out in your written scope before you start.
 Do I need a retainer?
 No. The build is a fixed price, and ongoing SEO is optional. The only regular charge on a site is hosting and care.
 What should a straightforward service site cost?
 From Andy, £600 buys five pages and £995 buys eight, with each page beyond those at £125. Hosting and care is £10 a month after launch.
 How quickly can the old site be replaced?
 Budget 1 to 3 weeks from deposit to the switch. Knowing what you want to change speeds it up, and your existing site stays up until the new one is ready.
 Does the site belong to me when it is finished?
 You own the site once it is paid for. That is true whether or not you go on to take any ongoing support.

## https://guildfordwebsitedesign.co.uk/about-andy

Who updates your site
 Andy Norman, bringing Guildford sites up to date 
 After starting as a field engineer, Andy put in more than 30 years across field service and managed print, finishing as a service manager, and then founded Antek Automation.
 Service work has a simple rule: leave things in better order than you found them. Applied to a Guildford firm's website, it means dealing with the outdated parts rather than painting over them.
 How he approaches an old website
 He asks what has changed since it was built. Services, prices, staff and the customers you want are all fair game, and the design is settled only after the facts are right.
 Based at Chantry Way, Andover

 A Google profile goes stale in the same way a website does. Monthly SEO in Guildford from Antek Automation costs £497 and keeps that profile, your reviews and your map positions under regular attention.

 Where this service stops
